closure_conflict: The closure request changed or cannot perform this action in its current state. Refresh and try again.
platform_access_blocks_closure: Remove this account's platform access through the protected administrator workflow before processing closure.
identity_unavailable: The identity service could not complete the request. Retry later; contact an administrator if the problem continues.
invalid_principal: The principal data is invalid. Check the login name, profile, email, and password requirements.
invalid_service_account: The service account data is invalid. Check its name, status, expiry, credential scopes, and tenant state.
login_name_exists: This login name is already in use. Choose a different login name.
principal_anonymization_confirmation: The confirmation does not match this principal's login name. Erasure cannot be undone, so it only proceeds for a caller that named the right subject.
principal_anonymized: This principal has already been erased. The record is a tombstone and cannot be changed back.
principal_lifecycle_version_conflict: The retention policy changed while you were deciding. Reload it and make the decision against what it says now.
principal_not_found: The requested principal was not found in this tenant. Verify the principal identifier and tenant, then try again.
principal_retained: The retention deadline has not passed, or a legal hold is in force. Erasure stays blocked until both are clear.
principal_shared_beyond_tenant: This account also belongs to another organization or holds platform authority. Suspending or restoring it here would apply everywhere, so remove its membership in this organization instead.
principal_suspension_required: Suspend the principal first. Erasing an account that can still sign in would leave sessions holding data that no longer exists.
service_account_credential_limit: This service account already has the maximum number of active credentials. Revoke an unused credential before creating another.
service_account_credential_not_found: The requested service account credential was not found. Refresh the credential list and try again.
service_account_not_found: The requested service account was not found in this tenant. Verify the identifier and tenant, then try again.
service_account_version_conflict: The service account changed after you opened it. Refresh the account and apply your changes again.
